name: Sakakino Ayana
source: [spoiler]The older sister of Konomi who was in love with the protagonist one year before the main story of this game happens. She dies in a fire which nearly causes a mental break for the protagonist. She later returns as Ayasaki Nanoka, in order to bring happiness to protagonist. Her name Sakakino Ayana can be rearrange into Ayasaki Nanoka.[/spoiler]
